## Task / milestone
Task IDs and dependency/base branch. Keep draft until review-ready. Describe only implemented changes.

## Behavior and archive safety
What changed, what stayed compatible, and evidence that existing/unknown files are not overwritten. Note migration and WhatIf effects.

## Actual verification
Commands, source commit, OS/PowerShell/tool versions, pass/fail/skip/not-run counts and sanitized evidence. Separate fixture-helper tests from product tests. State unavailable engines/manual checks.

## Risk and privacy review
Secret-safe logs/artifacts, no new runtime dependencies, no machine-wide security/power changes, no unrequested deployment.

## Handoff
Current task state, next task/prompt, known limitations and owner gates. Do not merge/publish automatically. No private feed URLs or real podcast media in this PR.
